concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-accept-node]] - Braintree Node.js dispute acceptance by ID, restricted to merchants with Control Panel dispute access, with the prior-refund do-not-accept warning and an unreconstructed missing status-eligibility value
warnings: The eligibility status value is absent from the collected sentence (`status of.`); never infer or reconstruct it from adjacent or unrelated dispute documentation.
Preserve the instruction not to accept a dispute after refunding the disputed transaction and the alternate file-or-text evidence route.
Keep API availability qualified to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
Treat the linked Dispute response and evidence pages as navigation only; this source does not establish their unread status schema, evidence request fields, or broader dispute lifecycle.
